## Pull Request

### What / 做了什么

### Why / 为什么

### How / 如何实现

### Testing / 验证

- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] Manual demo or API smoke test completed when applicable
- [ ] 已完成适用的手动 Demo 或 API 烟测

### Privacy and boundaries / 隐私与边界

- [ ] No `.env`, API key, real student material, mailbox export, or private workspace data
- [ ] No automatic sending, submission, or unreviewed fact/status writeback
- [ ] No copied external project source
- [ ] 未包含密钥、真实学生资料、邮箱导出或私有 workspace
- [ ] 未增加未经确认的自动发送、提交或事实/状态写回
- [ ] 未复制外部项目源码

### Rollback / 回滚
